dct_title_s: Howard County, Iowa, 1964, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol SN. Form of individual image numbering: SN-1EE-[number], SN-2EE-[number], or SN-3EE-[number]. "Year Flown 1964". Flown by General Aerial Surveys, Houston 17, Texas. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
